about_the_game:
A True Struggle for Survival

Set in a vast wasteland devastated by an atomic bomb, this experience combines slow-paced, atmosphere-focused gameplay with exploration, looting, and equipment progression that you can enjoy together with your friends. Players can roam dangerous zones, collect valuable loot to sell and grow stronger, and upgrade their vehicles with the money they earn to push deeper into more distant and deadly areas.
Explore, loot, and survive!

Key Features

Post-Apocalyptic Atmosphere:
Regions distorted by radiation, ruined structures, and a threatening silence after nuclear destruction.

Co-op Survival With Friends:
Head out to explore with your team, share loot or trade to progress together.

Vehicle and Equipment Upgrades:
Sell the valuable loot you collect to obtain powerful gear, upgrade your vehicle, and advance into more dangerous zones.

Dynamic Danger Areas:
Radiated fields, creatures, raider groups, and environmental threats create risk at every step.

Extensive Loot and Trading System:
Gather rare parts, trade to get richer, and acquire the best equipment.

Risk–Reward Balance:
The farther you go, the greater the danger… but the rewards grow with it.

Who Is It For?

Perfect for players who enjoy exploration, teamwork, and a post-apocalyptic atmosphere; ideal for anyone who likes taking risks, gathering loot, trading, and developing their character. Great for those who enjoy tension, strategic progression, and the feeling of constant threat.

Visual Style

The game offers a dark and striking post-nuclear aesthetic supported by modern graphics. Radiation-warped landscapes, fog-covered areas, ruins, and an oppressive atmosphere keep the player on edge at all times.

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains sudden jumpscares, a dark and intense atmosphere, and a horror story inspired by real-life events. It may be disturbing to some players.
